```python
script = '''
import fitz  # PyMuPDF
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io
import os

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)

print("=" * 60)
print(f"PDF: {pdf_path}")
print(f"Total pages: {len(doc)}")
print("=" * 60)

# --- PART 1: Extract embedded text from ALL pages ---
print("\\n" + "=" * 60)
print("PART 1: EXTRACTED TEXT (all pages)")
print("=" * 60)
full_text = ""
for page_num in range(len(doc)):
    page = doc[page_num]
    text = page.get_text()
    full_text += text
    print(f"\\n--- Page {page_num + 1} ---")
    print(text.strip() if text.strip() else "(no embedded text)")

# --- PART 2: OCR on the first page image ---
print("\\n" + "=" * 60)
print("PART 2: OCR ON FIRST PAGE IMAGE")
print("=" * 60)

first_page = doc[0]
# Render page to image at 300 DPI for good OCR quality
zoom = 300 / 72  # 300 DPI
mat = fitz.Matrix(zoom, zoom)
pix = first_page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)

# Convert to PIL Image
img_data = pix.tobytes("png")
img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_data))

# Save the first page image
img.save("output/first_page.png")
print(f"First page image saved to output/first_page.png ({img.size[0]}x{img.size[1]} px)")

# Perform OCR
ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
print("\\nOCR Result:")
print("-" * 40)
print(ocr_text.strip() if ocr_text.strip() else "(no text detected by OCR)")

# Save results to files
with open("output/extracted_text.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(full_text)

with open("output/ocr_first_page.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(ocr_text)

print("\\n" + "=" * 60)
print("Files saved:")
print("  - output/extracted_text.txt  (full extracted text)")
print("  - output/ocr_first_page.txt (OCR of first page)")
print("  - output/first_page.png     (first page image)")
print("=" * 60)

doc.close()
'''

await make_directory("./output")
await write_file("./script.py", script)
print("Script written.")

result = await run_command("python ./script.py")

ocr_text = await read_file("./output/ocr_first_page.txt")
print(ocr_text[:3000] if len(ocr_text) > 3000 else ocr_text)
```
